notes.title: We've Been Nominated!
notes.content:
[h2][b]CROWDED. FOLLOWED. has been nominated for the Technical Achievement Award as part of The Horror Game Awards! [/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053896/5647895e5e216c827ae9754f0e0563a8e6d8d204.jpg[/img]
[h3] We are so chuffed to have been nominated!
[b]There are 3 days left, so please consider giving us your vote at: thehorrorgameawards.com/vote/[/b]


Thank you!! [/h3]
